description: With the local service stopped, the comment error reads 'Failed to fetch' (raw browser text). A second retry control (Retry connection) shows in the page banner at the same time, and the project switcher still says 'Saved locally · synced · unconfirmed change'.
expected: 'Couldn't reach Pardner on this computer. Your comment is kept and will be sent when you retry.' One retry control; status reads disconnected.
actual: 'Failed to fetch' plus two retry buttons, and 'synced' in the switcher.
suggested_fix: Map network TypeErrors to friendly copy; let one retry action cover both; derive switcher status from connection state.

description: Task History omits comment additions but includes comment edits, resolves and deletes ('edited a comment on this task', 'kept one version…', 'This comment was later deleted.').
expected: History either covers comment lifecycle events consistently or omits them all (they are in Comments and Activity).
actual: Only non-add comment events appear in History.
suggested_fix: Apply the same comment-event filter to comment.edit/resolve/delete in History.
